syncStatus.trustHint: Registration or decryptability does not establish a verified host handshake or trust. Independent handshake, host key and TLS trust observations are not collected here. See actual rejection reasons in check summaries. Secret values are never displayed; manage materials in the client project.
syncStatus.directoryHint: Catalogue management does not grant project content access. NONE, explicit deny, current role and membership remain server authority.
syncStatus.defaultsHint: Effective values, sources and reasons describe the current member. Only selected sync capabilities are patched; other capabilities remain. Use existing member / project ACL management for explicit delegation and deny.
syncStatus.noMaterials: No registered material metadata in this project.
syncStatus.noSources: No sources in this project yet.
syncStatus.checkHint: Current check, latest attempt and latest success are distinct. No current check does not mean no prior failures. This page does not start checks or apply changes.
syncStatus.auditHint: Sync events are filtered from a bounded server audit page: {scanned} scanned, page limit {limit}. This is not the complete history.
syncStatus.noAudit: No sync management events on this bounded page; this does not imply none in history.
syncStatus.auditDenied: Current permission does not allow audit reads.
syncStatus.conflict: The version changed. The draft is preserved. Reload, compare and explicitly save.
syncStatus.unknownAccess: The access save result is unknown. Read the current version and compare; writes are not replayed automatically.

reasons.SYNC_CACHE_MISS: The source returned HTTP 304, but no matching cache is available to recover the specification text
reasons.SYNC_CONTENT_HANDOFF_FAILED: The read source content could not be safely handed to the sync coordinator; the check failed
reasons.SYNC_CONTENT_DIGEST_MISMATCH: The fixed content SHA-256 digest does not match its record; integrity validation rejected it
reasons.SYNC_CONTENT_BYTES_MISMATCH: The fixed content byte count does not match its record; integrity validation rejected it
reasons.SYNC_CONTENT_REFERENCE_MISMATCH: Protected references to the same fixed content are inconsistent; the operation was rejected
reasons.SYNC_CONTENT_NONCANONICAL: The fixed content is not in the required canonical serialized form; integrity validation rejected it
reasons.SYNC_INPUT_INVALID: The sync input does not satisfy the declared contract; the operation was rejected
reasons.SYNC_INVALID_FILES: Project files used by sync are invalid or cannot be read safely; the operation was rejected
reasons.SYNC_STAMP_MISMATCH: The fixed project, source or mapping version identity does not match; check again
reasons.SYNC_SOURCE_MODULE_MISMATCH: The source specification has no uniquely matching target module; the candidate cannot be built
reasons.SYNC_CROSS_SOURCE_OWNERSHIP: The entity is managed by another source and cannot be taken over
reasons.SYNC_PROTECTED_REFERENCE: Asset references cannot be safely preserved; the operation was rejected
reasons.SYNC_PROTECTED_LOCAL_ASSET: The change would remove a protected local asset; the operation was rejected
reasons.SYNC_DECISION_DUPLICATE: Duplicate decisions were submitted for one change; retain one explicit choice
reasons.SYNC_DECISION_UNKNOWN: A decision references a change absent from the current candidate; review the candidate again
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_DECISION_REQUIRED: A source addition meets an existing local asset; explicitly map the asset or keep the current one
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_KIND_MISMATCH: The selected asset and source entity have different kinds and cannot be mapped
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_PARENT_MISMATCH: The selected asset parent does not match the source parent relationship; mapping was rejected
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_PARENT_NOT_SELECTED: The parent change was kept current; select a compatible parent before mapping this child
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_TARGET_ACTIVE: The selected mapping target is still used by another source entity; choose another target
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS: The selected mapping target matches multiple entities and cannot be identified uniquely
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_TARGET_DUPLICATE: Multiple source entities cannot map to one target asset; choose distinct targets
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: The selected asset is absent or managed by another source; choose another target
reasons.SYNC_ROLLBACK_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The fixed before/after rollback content does not match the history references; rollback was rejected
reasons.SYNC_ROLLBACK_HISTORY_MISMATCH: Content digests or asset versions in rollback history do not match the fixed content; rollback was rejected
reasons.SYNC_ROLLBACK_STAMP_MISMATCH: The rollback target does not match the current project, source or mapping identity; rollback was rejected
reasons.SYNC_DECISION_REQUIRED: Choose a decision for every change
reasons.SYNC_KEEP_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Confirm the baseline update after choosing keep current
reasons.SYNC_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED: Check and select a fixed candidate first
reasons.authorization-changed: Authorization changed; check or explicitly authorize again
reasons.SYNC_MAPPING_DECISION_INVALID: Mapping to an existing entity requires a valid UUID
reasons.SYNC_CONTEXT_CHANGED: Project or workspace changed; the old result was discarded
reasons.online-session-changed: Online session changed; reload the current project
reasons.SYNC_SOURCE_BUSY: This source still owns check resources; wait for collection
reasons.SYNC_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT: Project or host concurrency is full
reasons.source-busy: Source resources are busy; the check is durably waiting
reasons.storage-limit: Synchronization storage is full; adjust limits or release eligible history
reasons.SYNC_PROCESS_UNCOLLECTED: Source process collection is unproven; occupancy is retained. Inspect the host processes
reasons.SYNC_MATERIAL_RELEASE_FAILED: Private materials were not safely released; source occupancy is retained
reasons.SYNC_DESTINATION_REJECTED: This destination was not approved; the source was not read
reasons.SYNC_NETWORK_DENIED: Destination or redirect is outside this check’s approved host, port and IP range
reasons.SYNC_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: A supported installed Git/OpenSSH tool is missing; check local tool settings
reasons.SYNC_HOST_KEY_MISMATCH: Host key mismatch or unknown; SSH connection refused
reasons.SYNC_SSH_AUTH_FAILED: SSH key or passphrase authentication failed
reasons.SYNC_MATERIAL_INVALID: Source material format is invalid; check its purpose and registration
reasons.runtime-unavailable: Private server runtime is unavailable or incompatible
reasons.runtime-uncertain: Host outcome is uncertain; no automatic reread
reasons.SYNC_OPERATION_UNKNOWN: Commit outcome is unconfirmed; query the original intent receipt without reapplying
reasons.SYNC_OPERATION_PENDING: The original operation is committing or reconciling
reasons.SYNC_SCHEDULE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Schedule authorization outcome is uncertain; read its current state without replaying
reasons.SYNC_POLICY_INVALID: Synchronization policy is invalid; repair saved settings
reasons.forbidden: The current member lacks permission for this operation
reasons.material-changed: Captured material rotated or was removed; explicitly authorize again
reasons.occurrence-capacity: Occurrence capacity is full; the schedule is paused
reasons.rule-invalid: The rule is invalid under current limits
reasons.SYNC_ROLLBACK_CURRENT_CHANGED: Project, source or baseline changed; this entry cannot be rolled back
reasons.SYNC_HOST_UNAVAILABLE: Synchronization host is not configured or unavailable
reasons.SYNC_READ_ONLY: Workspace is read-only; synchronization changes cannot be committed
reasons.SYNC_INTENT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Local intent storage is unavailable; retain the original intent ID for reconciliation
reasons.SYNC_SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: Source document exceeds the configured byte limit
reasons.SYNC_COMPARE_INPUT_BYTES_EXCEEDED: Three-way comparison input exceeds the configured byte limit
reasons.SYNC_COMPARE_OUTPUT_BYTES_EXCEEDED: Fixed candidate output exceeds the configured byte limit
reasons.SYNC_GIT_DISK_LIMIT: Git temporary materials reached the sampled disk threshold; the check stopped
reasons.SYNC_PROCESS_INPUT_LIMIT: Source-tool input exceeds the controlled process byte budget
reasons.SYNC_PROCESS_OUTPUT_LIMIT: Source-tool output exceeds the controlled process byte budget
reasons.SYNC_HOST_CONFIG_INVALID: Synchronization host configuration is invalid; check trusted tools and private storage
reasons.SYNC_BUSY: Source-host execution slots are occupied; wait for collection
reasons.SYNC_CONTEXT_STALE: The source host’s captured project context is stale; check again
reasons.SYNC_NETWORK_SNAPSHOT_INVALID: Captured network configuration is invalid; check the project network selection and materials
reasons.SYNC_NETWORK_FAILED: Connecting to the specification source failed; check reachability and approved addresses
reasons.SYNC_PROXY_UNSUPPORTED: This source does not support the selected proxy route; choose a supported network profile
reasons.SYNC_TLS_FAILED: Source TLS verification failed; check trusted CAs and client certificates
reasons.SYNC_TLS_POLICY_INVALID: Source TLS configuration cannot provide required verification; connection refused
reasons.SYNC_CONNECT_TIMEOUT: Source connection exceeded the configured connection timeout
reasons.SYNC_HTTP_STATUS: The specification source returned an unsuccessful HTTP status
reasons.SYNC_READ_FAILED: Reading source content failed; no applicable candidate was created
reasons.SYNC_REDIRECT_INVALID: The source redirect destination is invalid; reading was refused
reasons.SYNC_REDIRECT_LIMIT: Source redirects exceeded the configured local limit
reasons.SYNC_ENCODING_INVALID: Specification text encoding is invalid; parsing stopped
reasons.SYNC_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: The specification uses an unsupported text encoding
reasons.SYNC_GIT_UNAVAILABLE: A supported Git tool is unavailable; check the host installation
reasons.SYNC_GIT_AUTH_FAILED: Git HTTPS authentication failed; check the captured authentication material
reasons.SYNC_GIT_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED: The installed Git lacks required secure-read capabilities
reasons.SYNC_GIT_REF_NOT_FOUND: The requested Git reference was not found in the repository
reasons.SYNC_GIT_PATH_NOT_FOUND: The specification entry file was not found in the fixed commit
reasons.SYNC_GIT_OBJECT_INVALID: The repository entry is not a supported ordinary file object
reasons.SYNC_GIT_LFS_UNSUPPORTED: The entry is a Git LFS pointer; this check does not download LFS content
reasons.SYNC_GIT_READ_FAILED: The controlled Git read failed; no applicable candidate was created

reasons.SYNC_SSH_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE: The SSH source has no explicit supported network route

reasons.SYNC_PROCESS_HELPER_UNAVAILABLE: The required controlled-process helper is missing; check the client installation
reasons.SYNC_PROCESS_HELPER_INVALID: The controlled-process helper installation identity is invalid; execution refused
reasons.SYNC_PROCESS_START_FAILED: The controlled source process could not start; check host tool configuration
reasons.SYNC_INTERRUPTED: Source reading was interrupted; waiting for resource collection
reasons.SYNC_DISK_MONITOR_FAILED: Git temporary disk usage could not be checked reliably; reading stopped
reasons.source-read-failed: Source reading failed; inspect the current diagnostic, connection and materials
reasons.comparison-failed: Comparing the fixed three-way content failed; no applicable candidate was created
reasons.material-invalid: Registered source material has an invalid format or purpose
reasons.server-restarted: The server restarted; the previous check is uncertain and will not be reread automatically

sync.confirmedWaiting: Save confirmed; other attempts are still settling. The original operation remains locked.
sync.confirmedReload: Save confirmed. Explicitly reload and compare the current policy; an old response does not overwrite the current view.
sync.clientEditor: Maintain source URLs, Git refs, schedules and diff decisions in the client project.
sync.nextCheck: Changes apply to the next check admission. Started checks retain their fixed policy.
sync.deploymentReadOnly: Deployment constraints are read only and configured by the server administrator
sync.retentionHint: History entry limits apply per source. Large content follows retention windows and protected references; total content bytes remain subject to project/global storage quotas. Permanent lightweight receipts support idempotent reconciliation and do not retain large content forever. Git disk thresholds are sampled, not a guarantee of zero overshoot.
sync.draftHint: Empty drafts keep the current value. Restoring inheritance requires an explicit save. Base units must remain integers; the server rechecks parent, deployment and budget constraints.
sync.readOnly: Current authority permits reading policy only.

errors.SYNC_POLICY_INVALID: Saved values conflict with the current parent, deployment or budget constraints. Repair them before starting new checks; no effective policy is available while invalid.
errors.SYNC_POLICY_REVISION_CHANGED: The version changed. The draft is preserved. Reload, compare and explicitly save again.
errors.forbidden: Current permission does not allow this action.
errors.project_forbidden: Current project permission does not allow this action.
errors.unauthorized: The session expired. Sign in again.
errors.contentUnreadable: No project content read permission. Management catalogue access does not grant content access.
errors.number: Enter a value within the allowed range that converts exactly to integer base units.
errors.unknown: The save result is unknown. Editing is locked; explicitly retry only the original operation and request.
errors.other: Loading failed. Reload and check the current session and permission.

accessObservationStates.bounded: Only finite authenticated public view/download facts within the retention period are retained; this is not a complete access count.
accessObservationStates.disabled: Access detail retention is disabled; this does not prove no visits. Management audit remains enabled.
accessObservationStates.observations-missing: Public-access observation gaps occurred process-wide since startup and may involve this scope; neither zero visits nor a precise loss count can be inferred.

collaboration.savedOriginStatus: Saved public origin rules (independent of enable)

originStatuses.valid: Saved origins are valid; this does not establish an enabled listener or readiness
originStatuses.invalid-origin-or-separation: Invalid origin or management-origin separation. Unsafe values are hidden; ask the deployment administrator to check them.
originStatuses.invalid-origin: Invalid saved management origin. The value is hidden; credentials, paths, query and fragments are not allowed.

collaboration.resourceMetadataTitle: Deployment hard resources and application budgets (read-only)
collaboration.noStandaloneMaximum: No standalone maximum; subject to the complete total-memory budget
collaboration.resourceDefaultHint: An unset default means unconfigured, not zero or the recommendation. Values are saved configuration, not proof of external or runtime enforcement. Recommendations are listed separately below.

resourceCombinations.heap-cache-inflight-headroom-within-tota: Heap + cache + in-flight budget + host headroom must fit within total memory. The existing deployment validator checks this relationship when all four resource values are configured. Missing values make the full combination incalculable and do not establish OS enforcement or a satisfied budget.

resourceEffects.external-enforcement: Applied by the deployment platform; actual external enforcement is not verified
resourceEffects.deployment-configuration: Deployment resource configuration; runtime application is not established

resourceConstraints.external-enforcement-unverified: External enforcement is not verified. Unconfigured CPU/RSS values establish no hard limit.
resourceConstraints.heap-not-rss: Node heap does not limit total RSS; the complete total-memory relationship still applies.
resourceConstraints.complete-total-memory-budget: Check the complete heap, cache, in-flight, headroom and total-memory combination. Values are never silently reduced.

grantErrors.grant_revision_conflict: Grant revision conflict. Reload grant metadata, compare the retained choices and new revision, then explicitly submit. No automatic replay.
grantErrors.collaboration_grant_limit: The grant quota is exhausted. Explicitly adjust the grant arrangement or ask an administrator to check project and site quotas. No automatic creation.
grantErrors.grant_inactive: This grant is inactive and its old secret cannot be rotated. Reload and check expiry, responsibility and policy reasons. Explicitly request a new grant if appropriate; the old one never revives.
grantErrors.grant_publication_disabled: The publication is disabled. Reload its state and explicitly enable that version in the client or shared Mock control before another action. It is never enabled automatically.

collaboration.uncertainGrant: Operation is unresolved. Do not create again; reconcile the original intent.
collaboration.grantReconciled: Reconciliation complete. The secret cannot be retrieved. Reload metadata and explicitly rotate.

denials.content_unreadable: Content unreadable. The management directory permits recovery, not content access.
denials.logs_not_allowed: Mock log reading is not permitted. A call grant does not grant log access.
denials.audit_not_allowed: The independent audit read capability is not granted.

collaboration.mockReadinessHint: Runtime readiness is not established by an enabled publication. Throughput is not promised. Disabling may drain admitted requests.
collaboration.logFilters: Mock log filters for this version
collaboration.grantPublicId: Nonsecret grant public ID (not a member or IP)
collaboration.discarded: Entries discarded during this query's cleanup
collaboration.nextPage: Continue next page (an empty page is not the end)
collaboration.auditHint: The three domains are permission, execution and collaboration management records. Access details may be incomplete; retention 0 disables details, so an empty list does not prove no visits. Management records and hit logs have separate retention.
collaboration.noChangedLocations: Collected empty location list (no changed locations)
collaboration.rawRecords: Raw security records (advanced, collapsed by default)

logStates.disabled: Hit detail retention is disabled. This does not prove no visits.
logStates.bounded: Only bounded recent details are retained; older entries may be removed.
logStates.observations-missing: Observation gaps occurred process-wide since startup and may involve this version. They do not establish zero visits or precise per-version loss.

collaboration.clientEditing: Edit contracts, rules and publication previews in the client. Manage retained versions and grants here. New versions do not replace old links.
collaboration.revokeHint: Revocation, rotation and policy tightening restrict subsequent admission. They do not recall downloaded files, cut sent bytes or cancel admitted work. Rejoining never revives old secrets.
collaboration.directoryRefreshNeeded: Directory snapshot is stale. Explicitly reload current metadata; no invented revision or automatic write replay.
collaboration.durationHint: Duration starts at server creation; minimum / current maximum
collaboration.onceOnly: Secret is visible only in this creation or rotation reply. Save it securely; directories never return secrets.
collaboration.secretUnavailable: Secret cannot be obtained again. Reconcile the original operation, then explicitly rotate.

states.responsibility_changed: Responsibility changed; a new grant is required

collaboration.uncheckedHint: An unchecked runtime is not proven available; saving policy does not establish readiness. Configured origins, an actual bound listener and startup reconciliation are separate from publication or grant validity.
collaboration.restartRequired: Deployment changes require restart; no browser hot apply
collaboration.resourceHint: Recommendations, external CPU/RSS hard limits and Node heap settings are separate. Unconfigured limits do not establish OS enforcement; Node heap does not limit total RSS. A setting does not prove the running process applied it.

deploymentConstraints.fixed-http-https-private-endpoint: Fixed deployment HTTP/HTTPS endpoint; private address and path withheld
deploymentConstraints.secret-file-no-disclosure: Deployment secret file; path and content withheld
deploymentConstraints.local-expectation: Local expectation only; no negotiated identity without RPC
deploymentConstraints.deployment-network-isolation: Deployment network setting; isolation is not checked here
deploymentConstraints.public-bind: Loopback by default; public deployment needs an approved bind and origin
deploymentConstraints.zero-ephemeral-port: 0 requests an ephemeral bind; actual port shown separately
deploymentConstraints.public-origin-separation: Loopback HTTP or separate HTTPS origin; no credentials, paths, queries or fragments
deploymentConstraints.management-origin-separation: Remote/HTTPS public origins require a separate HTTPS management origin

resourceLabels.externalLimits_totalMemoryBytes: External RSS / total memory hard limit

collaboration.permissionHint: Explicit member denial overrides allowance. Allow still requires a valid role, no NONE/pending refusal, and upper capability limits. Effective facts describe the current administrator or selected member, not a role assigned to everyone.

errors.publication_revision_conflict: Publication revision conflict. Your choices are preserved. Reload publication and grant metadata, compare, then explicitly submit.
errors.grant_policy_disabled: Current policy no longer allows this grant. Check effective values and their sources. Old secrets never revive automatically.
errors.public_origin_unavailable: The public origin is unavailable. Ask the deployment administrator to check the separate public entry. Reconcile an uncertain operation before creating again.
errors.integer_required: Enter a valid safe integer. An empty number does not clear the local value.
errors.collaboration_policy_revision_conflict: Policy revision conflict. Your draft is preserved; explicitly reload and compare current values before saving.
errors.access_revision_conflict: Access revision conflict. Keep the draft, reload and compare changes.
errors.invalid_duration: Duration must be a safe integer from 60000 milliseconds through the current maximum. Your value is preserved; explicitly adjust it.
errors.external_not_allowed: Current policy does not allow external sharing. Check the effective source.
errors.download_not_allowed: Current policy does not allow external download. Explicitly clear the choice.

collaboration.title: Collaboration management
collaboration.consentHint: External sharing requires explicit deployment, workspace and project consent. Clearing local consent closes that layer. Policy allowance does not establish public service readiness.
collaboration.corsHint: Preflight uses exact deployment/platform origin ceilings. Actual calls still check project origins and authorization. CORS does not replace authentication or enable Cookie sharing.
collaboration.tighteningHint: Tightening may suspend existing grants; shorter retention may clean eligible records. Downloaded files are not recalled, and old links are not extended.

fields.publicReadInFlight: Public reads in flight per grant

effects.new-publications: New publications; no automatic upload or enabling
effects.new-grants: Expiry fixed at creation; old links not extended
effects.new-previews: New previews; current policy still applies to old previews
effects.new-operations: New operations; no automatic retry after deadline
effects.new-projections-and-existing-grant-compl: New projections and existing grant compliance
effects.new-storage-writes: New storage writes; reject when full
effects.new-plans-and-current-calls: New plans and current call restrictions
effects.new-rpc-calls: New RPC calls, within the remaining operation deadline

scheduling.grantChanged: Member eligibility changed or cannot be granted. Reload project eligibility and review the draft; the server remains authoritative for execution rights.
scheduling.invalidGrantDraft: The draft contains ineligible or no longer visible member selections. Explicitly remove them before saving.
scheduling.grantsHelp: Manage permission here. Business plans remain in the client project. Workspace roles do not replace effective project eligibility; platform identity does not grant project execution rights.
scheduling.implicitAdmin: Project administrators already have schedule management permission; no explicit grant is needed.

grantReasons.editor-required: Only effective project editors can receive an explicit grant.
grantReasons.qualified: Currently eligible to execute in this project and to receive independent schedule management permission.

scheduling.channelValidationHelp: Byte budgets use integer UTF-8 bytes, durations must convert exactly to integer milliseconds, attempts are integers and ratios are 0–100%.

appliesByField.maxSchedules: Checked on creation; paused undeleted plans count. Lowering the cap does not delete existing plans.
appliesByField.minIntervalMs: Rechecked on create, update and enable; cannot be below the parent minimum. No hard real-time guarantee.
appliesByField.lateToleranceMs: Fixed at occurrence evaluation; at least twice the effective scan interval.
appliesByField.misfire: Fixed at recovery; catch-up must be explicitly enabled.
appliesByField.catchupWindowMs: Fixed recovery lookback; cannot exceed the queue deadline.
appliesByField.overlap: Applies to later triggers; never replaces or reclaims in-flight tasks.
appliesByField.queueTimeoutMs: Absolute deadline fixed at trigger time; retries do not extend it. Cannot exceed the maximum.
appliesByField.maxQueueTimeoutMs: Every new occurrence uses the lower saved timeout/current cap, including existing enabled plans. Sealed deadlines remain unchanged; started tasks are not stopped.
appliesByField.maxPendingDeliveries: Checked on new outbox admission; capacity failures remain visible in-app.
appliesByField.historyRetentionDays: Only ended details without active or pending-delivery references are cleared; deduplication summaries remain.
appliesByField.notificationRetentionDays: Only ended notification details without active or pending-delivery references are cleared; identity summaries remain.

scheduling.controlHelp: Mode changes are a controlled handoff: the persisted generation advances and old generations cannot submit. Align deployment and persisted mode before restarting. No external driver is available. Platform identity does not grant workspace or project execution permission.

keyStates.unavailable: Deployment key or encrypted channel material is unreadable

channelReasons.unsupported-origin: The legacy origin is outside the supported input range. Explicitly repair the address.
channelReasons.channel-key-unavailable: The deployment key or encrypted channel material is unreadable. Contact the deployment administrator.

scheduling.rotationConfirm: I confirm address or secret rotation stops old unconfirmed deliveries.
scheduling.deleteChannelHelp: Delete channel “{name}”? Future deliveries stop; in-app events remain.
scheduling.writeOnly: Write-only; leave empty to keep when editing
scheduling.channelWriteHelp: Empty URL and secret inputs keep existing values when editing. Both are required on create; the secret must be 16–256 UTF-8 bytes. Every update creates a new channel version and stops old unconfirmed deliveries; old notifications are never forwarded to the new address.
scheduling.deliveryApplies: Budgets are fixed for new deliveries; the attempt count includes the first attempt. Body and response budgets use UTF-8 bytes. The server enforces deployment limits.
scheduling.channelHelp: Full URLs and signing secrets are write-only. Saving sends no test notification; new channels default to disabled. An unavailable origin does not mean the address was cleared. Available does not mean outbound access is authorized or delivery succeeded.
scheduling.originHelp: Notification channels currently support ASCII DNS names and IPv4/IPv6 addresses only; internationalized domain names (IDN/punycode) are not supported yet.
scheduling.outboundHelp: Deployment administrators control allowed origins, address ranges and additional HTTP permission. This form cannot broaden them; every connection is checked again.
scheduling.name: Name

keyStatuses.unavailable: Unavailable; check deployment key and origin

scheduling.validationHelp: Enter a count within its range or a duration that converts exactly to integer milliseconds.

errors.rotation_confirmation_required: Explicit confirmation is required: address or secret rotation stops old unconfirmed deliveries.
errors.forbidden: You do not have management permission for this scope. Contact its administrator.
errors.project_forbidden: You do not have management permission for this project.
errors.version_conflict: The version changed. Reload the latest values, review the retained draft, then explicitly save.
errors.validation_failed: The settings violate a range, parent constraint or field relationship. Check values and sources.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.other: The request did not complete. Check the safe reason code.

scheduling.emptyHelp: Empty inputs keep explicit values. Inherit parent marks a reset draft, applied only when saved. The server enforces parent constraints.
scheduling.applies: Applies to new admissions; lower quotas do not delete plans or stop started tasks. The minimum interval is checked on create, update and enable. Retention only clears ended details without active references.

stressCapacity.title: Current resource occupancy
stressCapacity.drainHint: Blocks new admission only; active jobs are not terminated.

agents.stressBudgetHint: Zero stress job slots pauses new stress tasks. Numeric memory is not an RSS hard limit; policy memory is per execution process and failure samples are per entire task.
agents.allocationLoading: Reading current allocation. Editing and saving are disabled until it completes.
agents.allocationFailed: Allocation could not be read. Reload it successfully before editing.

validation.numberMilliseconds: Enter a finite number of seconds that converts exactly to an integer number of milliseconds.
validation.integer: The value must be an integer in its base unit.
validation.integerMilliseconds: The value must be an integer number of milliseconds; seconds cannot contain actual sub-millisecond precision.
validation.invalid: This value does not match the allowed type or range for this setting.

agents.queueNever: Disable automatic queue expiry (capacity limits still apply)
agents.retentionHint: A shorter retention period may remove archived results with no active references during subsequent cleanup.
agents.title: Agent nodes
agents.scopeHint: Manage agent infrastructure and policy here. Edit request authentication, environments, data, and tests in the client project.
agents.conflict: Another administrator changed this configuration. Reload and review the differences before saving; this draft will not overwrite the server automatically.
agents.allocations: Allocate an agent to workspace projects
agents.inheritHint: The table shows defaults, server inheritance sources, and effective values. Leave an edit blank to keep the current setting. New values affect future admission, not started tasks.
agents.name: Node name
agents.applicationHint: A successful save does not mean the agent applied it. Availability and configuration application are separate. If runtime and saved versions differ, saved values must not be treated as current runtime values.
agents.platformOnly: Only a platform superadmin can change shared node configuration. Project administration does not grant this authority.
agents.trustedRisk: Trusted Core scripts may access and exfiltrate authentication material in authorized requests and responses. node:vm and child processes under the same account do not provide strong isolation. Use only for trusted internal tests; enabling the node still requires project approval.
agents.grantsHint: The platform directory includes workspaces you have not joined. A grant allows the workspace to allocate this agent; it does not grant membership or project content access. Revocation removes downstream allocations and associations.
agents.enrollmentHint: This credential is for agent enrollment only. It is hidden when dismissed or when leaving this node. Deliver it through a controlled channel.
agents.revokeConfirm: Confirm revoking this agent identity and blocking future admission
agents.requestedAgentUnavailable: The linked agent is not associated with this project. Ask a workspace/project administrator to check allocation and association. No other agent was selected automatically.
agents.trustConfirmation: I explicitly confirm: trusting the entire project approves future script changes, and scripts may access and exfiltrate authorized authentication material.
agents.invalidScriptVersion: Enter a real script ID and the complete 64-character lowercase content hash.
agents.projectUnavailable: Cannot read the specified project. Check the project link or ask an administrator for access, then reload.
agents.projectReadOnly: Your role can only read associated agents. Effective project OWNER/ADMIN is required to change associations, defaults, policy, and script approvals.
agents.scriptRecordsHint: Manage saved approval records here; these are not a scan of current project source. Copy the actual missing script ID and full content hash from the client's execution rejection. Edit scripts in the client. Tasks without scripts need no script approval.
agents.actualPermissionHint: An approval record does not guarantee current execution permission. Runtime admission still checks current authorization, node script mode, all actual dependencies, and compatibility.
agents.nodeScriptsDenied: This agent currently denies trusted scripts; saved approval cannot override node policy.

scriptModes.trusted-core: Allow trusted Core scripts (project approval still required)

fields.queueTimeoutMs: Queue deadline (— means no automatic expiry)

login.displayNameInvalid: Display name must be 1-32 non-blank characters

org.title: Organization
